thread:
sam-g: Heads up — we need to finalize the per-model/route SLO dashboard requirements. Scope: TTFT, P50/P95/P99, tokens/sec, and a couple UX bits for rollouts/canary comparison. Who owns the runtime + infra inputs?

maria-r: I can prototype the dashboard if we get a concrete list of metrics + label names. @dmitri can runtime emit everything we need?

dmitri: Runtime can emit these events/metrics: request_start, request_enqueued, first_token_emitted, request_end, inference_tokens_total (counter), inference_active_time_seconds (counter). We'll attach labels: model_name, route_id, model_variant, deployment_id, node_type, quant_level, region, customer_tier, batch_size, seq_len_bucket.

priya: Add queue_time/routing_latency too. Without them TTFT will be ambiguous (network vs runtime). Also suggest 'is_cache_hit' label.

dmitri: Good call. We'll send time_to_schedule and routing_proxy_latency spans and include is_cache_hit. TTFT will be first_token_emitted - request_enqueued.

eve-ml: For percentiles we should push histograms (Prometheus histograms or t-digests) at the runtime so we can compute p50/p95/p99 efficiently. Histograms per model+route+variant could be high cardinality — consider cardinality guardrails.

jonah: Infra preference: Prometheus histograms with recorded buckets, then aggregate in Thanos. We need to cap label cardinality: limit distinct model_variant values and avoid freeform tags. Also retention for high-res histograms needs budget.

maria-r: UX needs: dropdown for route_id, toggle per-model vs per-route, compare to baseline variant, and canary filter. Add an annotations lane for rollouts (show % traffic change).

dmitri: Example PromQL for p95 TTFT (rough):

```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(first_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_name, route_id, model_variant))
```

maria-r: For tokens/sec we want tokens emitted per second per route/model. Two useful expressions: tokens per request and tokens/sec across time. Example: tokens/sec = sum(rate(inference_tokens_total[1m])) by (model_name,route_id) / sum(rate(inference_active_time_seconds[1m])) by (model_name,route_id)

dmitri: We'll emit inference_active_time_seconds as a counter (sum of durations) to support that. Also expose inference_requests_total counter and inference_tokens_total counter so tokens-per-request is easy.

priya: Breakdowns we need in dashboards: p50/p95/p99 TTFT, request_duration Pxx, tokens_per_request, tokens_per_second, queue_time, routing_latency, cache_hit_rate. Also show distribution by seq_len_bucket (short/med/long).

eve-ml: Please also add model_quality tag so we can correlate perf regressions with evals; maybe a boolean 'regression_flag' from Optimize.

jonah: Infra TODOs: verify Prometheus scrape performance for histograms at target cardinality, set retention/compaction for 5m and 1h rollups. I'll run a simulation after we get expected label cardinality from runtime.

ashley: Dashboard UI TODOs: prototype in Grafana with variable for route_id and model_name, panels: Pxx latency, TTFT, tokens/sec, requests/sec, error rate, and a small table for canary diff (p95 delta). Also include alert panel summary (active alerts by model).

sam-g: Action items summarized:
- runtime (dmitri): add metrics/events + labels outlined above, open schema PR and example client patch.
- infra (jonah): run cardinality test, confirm Prom hist buckets and retention, ensure label passthrough through sidecar/proxy.
- eng-platform (maria-r, ashley): prototype Grafana dashboard + compare/canary panes; wire up alert thresholds.
- ml (eve-ml): provide per-model expected latency thresholds and seq_len buckets.
- sig-ops (priya): own alert rules and define what counts as regression for oncall.

Please reply if you want to be assigned or think we missed something.

dmitri: I'll open the PR with the metric names today and include example PromQL and a small test harness that emits synthetic traffic.

jonah: I'll schedule a cardinality run after we get the PR.

maria-r: I'll sketch the dashboard JSON this afternoon and post a link for review.

priya: I'll draft alert rules (p95 > threshold for 5m, sustained p99 spike) and post to this thread.

deploy-bot: metrics-schema-pr #421 merged to runtime/metrics with label changes (dmitri).

sam-g: Awesome — thanks all. Let's sync in the Wednesday infra sync to finalize thresholds. :thumbsup:
